entry_chain.role: Object boundary update after connectivity; dispatches by dimension and copies builder output into one boundary group.
3D wrapper selects element-width branch and orders equal-sum output faces by first and second nodes while carrying owner IDs.
Tetrahedral face generation and pairwise cancellation.
Comparator uses signed sum only; equal sums compare equal.
Embedded quicksort whose tie permutation is retained.
Selection-sort fallback for partitions of at most eight records; first strict maximum is swapped to the end.

tetrahedral_contract.candidate_order: Element input order, then local-face table order.
tetrahedral_contract.sort_key: Sum of three node IDs; face index travels with the key.
tetrahedral_contract.cancellation: In sorted order, skip a face whose first node was cleared. Search later candidates with the same sum for a face containing all three current node IDs. Clear the matching candidate's first node and discard the current face. Unpaired faces survive.
tetrahedral_contract.orientation: Surviving faces retain their original local-table orientation.
tetrahedral_contract.output: Four node slots per face, repeating the first node in the fourth slot, plus one-based owning element.
tetrahedral_contract.final_order: Within each equal-sum group, nested comparison/swap orders by first node then second node and carries the owning-element value.
tetrahedral_contract.implication: Duplicate cancellation is pairwise, so an odd number of identical faces can leave one face. Equal-key permutation can affect which orientation and owner survive.

design_choices: Portable vectors and indices replace original temporary buffers and pointer arithmetic.
Recursive sorting of disjoint partitions replaces the reference's explicit stack; comparator state is limited to the key.
Nonpositive node IDs, face-sum overflow and excessive counts are rejected outside the established compatibility domain.

limitations: Fixtures were independently prepared by another agent in the same project, not by an external benchmark authority.
The largest observed sort contains 12 records; large meshes and deep partitions need further evaluation.
The two eight-node observations contribute sort comparisons but no claim of implemented hexahedral boundary construction.
The first held-out launch timed out waiting for its observation gate and was terminated; it is excluded. The authoritative held-out capture uses the fresh retry directory and PID 2344.

remaining: Eight-node branch, including zero/repeated-node degeneracy classification
